there.line: But I don't see you anywhere
stanza: Foghorn through the night, calling out to sea
Protect my only light, for she once belonged to me
Let the waves rush in, let the seagulls cry
For if I live again, these hopes will never die
I can feel you standing there
But I don't see you anywhere

stanza: I don't need you, I don't need you
Besides I barely ever see you anymore

Young mothers love me, even ghosts of

Meet me anytime and anywhere

partner.line: And when I do it feels like you're only halfway there

air.line: And feel your voice all over everywhere
